name: _OMITTED_alerts-run
comment: DELIBERATELY NOT CAPTURED. /api/alerts/run (GET and POST) evaluates every alert rule and can send REAL webhook/email notifications (see src/services/clients/alert-store.ts runRules). The handler's only safety gate is the ALERTS_RUN_TOKEN env var, which is UNSET in .env.local in this environment -- so the `if (need)` guard is skipped entirely and ANY request (even with a wrong/missing token) would execute for real. There is no safe error-path to capture here without either setting ALERTS_RUN_TOKEN first or accepting a real side effect, so this handler is skipped for both GET and POST. Revisit once ALERTS_RUN_TOKEN is configured, or capture with a mocked alert-store in the Rust parity harness instead.
